comparison.objective: Steady a swinging conveyor carrier before removing a tin; different from tuning a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Dynamic stabilization and extraction from a suspended carrier versus collar tuning, setscrew locking, and controlled test cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Title specifies stabilization before removal; body, allowed swing, drop/damage criteria, and all specs are missing.
comparison.reason: Although both involve dynamic motion, this tests suppressing carrier swing during extraction, not modifying damping and verifying repeated stops.
